atoms.text:
Zuletzt kann man den Text noch sprachlich verbessern.

Man kann beispielsweise versuchen, ein abwechslungsreiches Vokabular zu verwenden. In formellen Texten sollte man stets Kurzformen vermeiden und häufig vorkommende Wörter durch Synonyme ersetzen.

hint.text: Synonyme sind Wörter, die dieselbe oder eine ähnliche Bedeutung haben und deshalb gegeneinander ausgetauscht werden können.

example.a:
The book wasn't boring, it was good.

Besser: The book was not boring, it was exciting.
example.sound: The book wasn't boring, it was good. <voice voiceLang='de' voice='f5'>Eine bessere Formulierung wäre:</voice> The book was not boring, it was exciting.

instruction.text: Ordne den umgangssprachlichen Formen ihre formellen Alternativen oder Synonyme zu.
In diesem Text gibt es ein Wort, das besonders oft wiederholt wurde. Tippe dieses in jedem Satz an.

atoms.b: Elena is excited because she is visiting her ((good)) friend Shayla for the summer holidays. Although they haven't seen each other for months, their friendship is still ((good)). They spend every day doing ((good)) activities together and in the evenings they sit by the lake and tell each other their secrets. They both don't want this holiday to end because they haven't had such a ((good)) time in a long time.

instruction.text: Ersetze good in jedem Satz mit einer passenden Alternative.
instruction.sound: Ersetze <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m2'>good</voice> in jedem Satz mit einer passenden Alternative.

atoms.b: Elena is excited because she is visiting her ((++close distant)) friend Shayla for the summer holidays. Although they haven't seen each other for months, their friendship is still ((++strong weak)). They spend every day doing ((++enjoyable risky)) activities together and in the evenings they sit by the lake and tell each other their secrets. They both don't want this holiday to end because they haven't had such an ((++amazing awful)) time in a long time.

atoms.b: “The Hate You Give” is a powerful and thought-provoking film that I enjoyed watching. ((++Firstly Secondly On_the_contrarary)), it tackles important issues such as racism and social justice and ((++furthermore to_begin_with lastly)) explores the complexity and challenges of identity. ((++Although Furthermore In_contrast)) I am more of a book person and had already read the novel, I found it pretty thrilling. ((++Overall, On_the_one_hand, Namely)) I can honestly recommend watching this film.
